name: LongBench v2
l2: 长上下文深度理解与推理
intro: LongBench v2通过503道英文四选一测试题评估长上下文深度理解与推理，覆盖6大类、20个子任务，上下文长度从8千到200万词。数据由97名英语熟练标注者结合任务专用来源构建，经长度与重合自动门、三个128k上下文模型筛查、24名独立专家限时复核及作者终审；15分钟人类基线准确率为53.7%。
build_method: 97名标注者, 自动质量门, 24名专家限时复核, 作者审计
metric: 选项准确率（总体/难度/长度）, 15分钟人类基线
task_type: 长上下文四选一问答, 深度理解与推理
eval_feature: 真实长上下文, 深度推理, 可靠选择题评测, 人类基线
scale: 503道英文测试选择题（论文未披露 train/dev/test 划分）
task_type_en: Long-context Four-choice MCQ, Deep Understanding and Reasoning
build_method_en: 97 Annotators, Automated Quality Gates, 24 Expert Timed Reviewers, Author Audit
eval_feature_en: Realistic Long Contexts, Deep Reasoning, Reliable MCQ Evaluation, Human Baseline
intro_en: LongBench v2 evaluates deep long-context understanding and reasoning with 503 English four-choice test questions across six categories and 20 subtasks, with contexts spanning 8,000 to 2 million words. Ninety-seven English-proficient annotators and task-specific sources feed length and overlap gates, three 128k-context model checks, timed review by 24 independent experts, and a final author audit; the 15-minute human baseline is 53.7% accuracy.
scale_en: 503 English test MCQs (the paper discloses no train/dev/test partition)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["6 categories / 20 subtasks"] --> B["97 annotators + task-specific sources"]
    B --> C["Plain text; length and overlap gates"]
    C --> D["English MCQ + A-D + answer + evidence"]
    D --> E{"All 3 128k LLMs correct?"}
    E -- Yes --> F["Feedback and rewrite"]
    E -- No --> G["24 experts: checklist, timed solve, answer verification"]
    G --> H{"Invalid, wrong, or correct within 3 min?"}
    H -- Yes --> F
    F --> I{"Rewrite limit reached?"}
    I -- No --> E
    I -- Yes --> J["Discard"]
    H -- No --> K["Hard iff at least 2 LLMs miss and expert needs over 10 min"]
    K --> L["Author audit; 503 English test MCQs"]
    L --> M["Core zero-shot / 2-call CoT; auxiliary RAG / no-context"]
    M --> N["Official A-D regex; exact-match accuracy"]

drawio_review_note: Rebuilt and re-reviewed against arXiv:2412.15204 Sections 3-4 and Appendices B-D plus the official LongBench v2 README, pred.py, result.py, prompts, and dataset card. The bilingual diagrams distinguish 97 annotators and task-specific context sources; separate 8,192-word and prior-overlap rejection gates; English A-D questions with answers and evidence; the GPT-4o-mini, GLM-4-Air, and GLM-4-Flash all-correct rewrite gate with middle truncation; 24 independent experts' checklist, timed solve, delayed answer/evidence reveal, and revision triggers; the neutral rewrite-limit gate required by the paper's main-text/appendix wording mismatch; the exact Hard conjunction; author audit and privacy/copyright review; the 503-question difficulty and length counts; core zero-shot/two-call CoT settings; auxiliary RAG/no-context analyses; and official regex parsing plus exact-choice accuracy.
